fix: A workspace member a project is shared with can chat inside it (member chat in shared project)
what_was_seen: The fix works in a browser. The member opened the shared project and asked "What is 12 plus 30?". The answer was "42 PELICAN" with no error, and the chat was still in the project after a reload. The same worked at "Can view" and at "Can edit". The owner did not see the member's chats. Stopping the share closed the project to the member. A personal workspace could not reach it. The rough edges are the move action working only on the second try, the wording of the error shown to a revoked member, and some cosmetic glitches.

cases.case: 1. Owner creates the project, sets the instruction, shares it with the workspace
cases.seen: Created "vsp shared 20261124T2330Z" in the team workspace "Test workspace (team)". Instruction saved in Project settings (toast "Project updated"). Project options > Share offers "Who can open it": "Everyone in the workspace can view" or "Only people you invite". After sharing, the member gets a row with a per-person dropdown: "Can view" (the default), "Can edit" or "No access". The dialog also has "Add people" and "Stop sharing".

cases.case: 2. Member chats in the shared project, then reloads
cases.seen: The project showed in the member's sidebar and on the Projects page. Its page showed a "Shared with you" badge and the text "This project's instructions and files are shared with you. Your chats and memories here stay private to you." Sent "What is 12 plus 30?" from the project page. The answer was "42 PELICAN" with no error. The chat opened as a "Work session" titled "Adding 12 and 30", and the owner's chat opened the same way. After a reload the chat was still there, and it was listed in the project's Chats tab. This ran at the default "Can view".

cases.case: 3. Member starts a chat outside the project, then moves it into the project
cases.seen: A plain chat answered "2 + 2 = 4." The product offers "Move to project" in the sidebar chat menu and in the header "Conversation options" menu. The first attempt (opening the submenu with ArrowRight, then a mouse click on the project name) did nothing: the chat stayed in Recents and was not in the project. The second attempt (header menu, ArrowRight, Enter) worked. The chat left Recents and appeared in the project's Chats tab as "2 Plus 2 Outside Chat". There was no toast.

cases.case: 4. Owner does not see the member's chats and can still chat in the project
cases.seen: While the member had 2 chats in the project, the owner's project page showed "No chats yet". The owner's search for "Outside Chat" gave "Found 0 results (0 conversations, 0 messages)". The owner sent "What is 20 plus 22?" in the project and got "42 PELICAN". Afterwards the owner's list showed only "Adding 20 and 22".

cases.case: 5. View-only versus edit access, repeat of case 2
cases.seen: The product offers "Can view", "Can edit" and "No access". Member set to "Can edit" (toast "Access updated"): "What is 12 plus 30? (can edit)" gave "42 PELICAN". Member set explicitly back to "Can view": "What is 12 plus 30? (view only)" gave "42 PELICAN". Both levels allow chatting, with no error.

cases.case: 6. Owner stops sharing; member reloads and tries to send in the old project chat
cases.seen: Owner's "Stop sharing" showed a confirmation: "Stop sharing vsp shared 20261124T2330Z? Everyone you shared it with loses access to its instructions and files. You keep the project and can share it again." Then the toast "Project is no longer shared". The member reloaded the project URL and saw "Project not found" / "This cloud project does not exist, is unavailable to this account, or was deleted." The Projects page showed "No projects yet." The access closure works. In the old chat, sending "And what is 5 plus 5?" gave "Response failed" and "Error: This project is archived, deleted, or unavailable. Remove the conversation from the project or restore the project before retrying." That text appeared three times (message, side panel, red banner with Retry). It is a readable message but misleading for a member, who cannot restore the project, and it carries an "Error:" prefix. The member's chats also vanished from the sidebar ("No conversations yet") though they still opened by URL. After the owner re-shared, all 4 chats were back in the project list.

cases.case: 7. Member switches to the personal workspace
cases.seen: The workspace menu lists "Personal (Only you)" and "Test workspace (team) member". In Personal ("Workspace: Personal") the Projects page showed "No projects yet." The direct project URL showed "Project not found" / "This cloud project does not exist, is unavailable to this account, or was deleted." The project was shared with the workspace at the time.

fix: Two scheduled-task fixes. Fix A: a scheduled run gets four minutes instead of 40 seconds. Fix B: deleting a shared schedule, or stopping sharing, kills its public link.
what_was_seen: Fix A could not be checked: every run, manual or scheduled, failed in about 334 ms with the usage-limit message, so none got far enough to hit the time limit. Fix B works. The shared link opened read-only when signed out. After the schedule was deleted, and again after "Stop sharing", reloading the link showed "Shared schedule unavailable". The stop-sharing schedule stayed in the list.

cases.case: A1 long-running run finishes with a real result
cases.seen: Created "vsc long 20261124T2330Z" (One Time, Auto). Run now at 3:24 PM gave the banner "Schedule finished with status failed." The card showed "Last run: Your rolling 5-hour usage limit is reached. Wait for earlier usage to leave the window or upgrade for a higher limit." History showed failed, 334 ms, manual. Changing the model to (model name) and running again at 3:26 PM failed the same way. The account had used its 50 credits, and /chat showed "You have used your 50 credits for this 5-hour window. Resets in 3 hr 20 min". This is a machine/account limit, so the 4-minute budget was never exercised.

fix: Slack link page now names the Slack account, requires a ticked box before Connect, and notifies the account owner afterwards.
what_was_seen: The new content of the page could not be reached on this machine. The running web server has no Slack app configured: there are no SLACK settings in apps/web/.env.local, and the server's check isSlackAppConfigured() therefore fails. The page's preview request (GET /api/slack/link) returns 503, and the server log says "AGI in Slack is not available right now". Settings > Slack app also says "AGI in Slack is not set up on this service yet." So after sign-in the page shows only the intro text, a red "Service temporarily unavailable", a disabled "Connect Slack account" button and "Cancel". The Slack workspace name, the Slack account, the AGI email, the checkbox and the hint never appeared. The same happened for link 2. Only the sign-in return (case 1) and the light/dark and width views (case 7, of this error state only) could be checked. I did not change any configuration. This is a setup limit, not a product failure; the fix itself is unverified.

cases.case: 1. Signed out, open link 1: sign in, then return to the link page
cases.seen: The page does not redirect on its own. It shows the intro, then the red text 'Sign in to the AGI account Slack should answer as. Sign in or create an account.', a disabled 'Connect Slack account' button and 'Cancel'. 'Sign in' leads to /login?redirectTo=/slack/link?token=.... After email plus code 424242 I was returned to /slack/link?token=... (not the home page). The signed-out view does not name the workspace or the Slack account.

cases.case: 2. Signed in: names the workspace, the Slack account, the AGI email; Connect unusable until the box is ticked, with a hint
cases.seen: Not reachable. The page shows only 'Service temporarily unavailable' under the intro text, with a disabled 'Connect Slack account'. There is no workspace name, no Slack account wording, no AGI email, no checkbox and no hint. Cause: the server has no Slack app config, so the preview returns 503.

cases.case: 3. Press Connect without ticking (click, and Tab then Enter): nothing is connected
cases.seen: There is no checkbox to leave unticked, so this does not test the new rule. Mouse click: Playwright reports the button 'is not enabled'. Keyboard: Connect is reachable by Tab (aria-disabled=true, not disabled), and Enter caused no request and no page change. Nothing was connected, but only because the page is in its unavailable state. No POST to the Slack link API occurred.

cases.case: 4. Tick the box and press Connect: clear success state; notice to the account owner
cases.seen: No checkbox exists and Connect stays disabled, so nothing could be connected. The owner notice could not be tested. Settings > Slack app (opened at /chat#settings/slack) has three sections: 'Waiting for your approval' ('Nothing is waiting for you.'), 'Your Slack accounts' ('No Slack accounts are linked yet.') and 'Slack workspaces you added' ('You have not added the app to a Slack workspace.'). It shows no notice, since nothing was linked.

cases.case: 5. Open link 1 again: says used or expired
cases.seen: Link 1 was never consumed, so there was nothing to reopen. Reopening it gives the same 'Service temporarily unavailable'. The expected 'used or expired' wording (in the code: 'This link has expired or was already used. Send AGI a message in Slack to get a new one.') was never shown.

cases.case: 6. Open link 2 and Cancel; connected accounts list in Settings; removal of the case 4 account
cases.seen: Link 2 shows the same 503 state ('Service temporarily unavailable', disabled Connect). Pressing Cancel on link 1's page leads to http://localhost:3000/ and nothing is connected. Connected accounts are listed in Settings > Slack app under 'Your Slack accounts', currently empty. Removal could not be checked because case 4 never connected anything.

cases.case: 7. Light and dark at widths 1280 and 390
cases.seen: Only the unavailable state was seen, not the real consent page. At 1280 and 390, in both light and dark, there is no overlap, cut-off or horizontal scroll. The grey disabled button has a dark label on grey in dark mode, which is low contrast but disabled. The theme toggle works.

fix: Idle sign-out now runs only when a person picks a limit; default is "Never". Checked in a browser over about 65 minutes with two accounts.
what_was_seen: The core fix works. The default is "Never". With 15 minutes chosen, A was signed out at about 15 minutes of idleness, twice. With the default, B stayed signed in at 30 and 62 minutes with no sign-out and no warning. Three expected pieces are missing or unverified. No "you will be signed out soon" warning appeared at any point in either 15-minute cycle. The sign-out landed on the marketing home page "/", not a sign-in page, and neither page says why. B's message at 62 minutes was not answered because the account had hit its usage limit, so the answer part of Case 5 is unchecked.

cases.case: Case 1 (vid-a): default shown and list of choices
cases.seen: Settings > Security > Security Settings > label "Sign out after inactivity" shows "Never". Choices: Never, 15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, 2 hours, 4 hours, 8 hours, 24 hours. Helper text: "Signs you out of this browser after this long without use. Never keeps you signed in until you sign out."

cases.case: Case 2 (vid-a): choose 15 minutes, save, reload
cases.seen: Chose "15 minutes" and pressed "Save Security Settings". After a reload the control still says "15 minutes". It also still said 15 minutes after signing in again. Minor: no confirmation text or toast was seen about 1 second after Save; the button only greyed out.

cases.case: Case 3 (vid-a): warning at about 13.5 minutes
cases.seen: Last touch 15:25:25. Screenshots at 13m31s, 14m00s and 14m35s show the plain chat page ("Good afternoon, Test") with no warning and no stay-signed-in control. Page text also contained no warning. I repeated the cycle (last touch 15:43:19) and polled every 18s from 7 to 15 minutes. No warning appeared at any poll.

cases.case: Case 3 (vid-a): signed out at about 16 minutes, on a sign-in page that says why
cases.seen: The sign-out happened at about 15 minutes. Cycle 1: between 14m35s and 15m10s. Cycle 2: between 14m50s and 15m07s. The page changed to the marketing home "/" (nav with "Sign in" and "Try chat"), not a sign-in page. Nothing on it says the person was signed out for inactivity. Pressing "Sign in" gave /login ("Log in or sign up") with no reason either. Signing in again with the email code worked and landed on /chat.

cases.case: Case 4 (vid-a): set back to Never and confirm it saves
cases.seen: Chose "Never" and saved. After a reload the control says "Never". Done twice, once after each cycle.

cases.case: Case 5 (vid-b): still signed in at 30 and 62 minutes, no warning, message answered
cases.seen: Signed in at 30 minutes (15:57:15) and 62 minutes (16:28:58): still on /chat as Test Premium with no warning or sign-out. I sent "vid-b: what is 7 plus 8? Reply with the number only." and it was not answered. The banner read "Your rolling 5-hour usage limit is reached. Wait for earlier usage to leave the window or upgrade for a higher limit. Resets in 2 hr 14 min." After a reload it read "You have used your 50 credits for this 5-hour window". The usage bar had shown 100% since sign-in at about 15:27. The session was still valid after the reload. The no-sign-out and no-warning part passed; the answered-message part could not be checked because of the usage limit.
